cohort: The study included 100 pregnant women with placenta previa.
finding: Patients with anterior placenta previa had a greater incidence of antepartum hemorrhage, caesarean births, lower mean birth weights, NICU hospitalizations, and poorer Apgar scores compared to those with posterior and lateral locations.
mod_finding: Patients with anterior placenta previa had a greater incidence of caesarean births (80%) than those with posterior (50%) and lateral (40%) locations.
